ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white) pixels localized to the lateral lobes and 55% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels occupying the central and peduncle-adjacent regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark pigmentation forms a broad V-shape extending toward the trailing edge. Lateral high-intensity fields are bisected by dark mottling. A prominent dark focal spot is located on the right lobe near the distal tip, and several smaller dark punctate marks are visible on the left lobe's white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel angle of 55 degrees; depth is significant, reaching roughly 15% of the total vertical fluke height at the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Amplitude of peaks is highest on the outer 25% of both lobes, with smaller, more consistent scalloping toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge from the notch to the distal tips; leading edges exhibit a convex trajectory toward the terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast yellowish-white clusters of roughly circular geometry (barnacles/encrustation) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Small, low-intensity circular spots are scattered across the white field of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct vertical low-intensity linear mark (rake scar) is visible on the right lobe, approximately mid-width. Shorter, horizontal linear disruptions are visible on the far left distal margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization and associated scarring on both fluke tips. Significant vertical linear scar on the right ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular 'bleeding' or 'flecked' boundary between the central black pigmentation and the lateral white pigmentation fields.
